mechanism.symptom: Every worker repeatedly tried branches 1, 2, 3, and 4, then logged no queued branch is currently selectable without creating another node.
mechanism.primary_cause: AgentSearch rerouted an entitled non-root tournament continuation through the allocation queue before executing the caller-owned node. The branch root ownership lock therefore outlived the discarded continuation.
mechanism.secondary_cause: The ordered queue selector treated every locked fallback root as unavailable and had no bounded single-worker orphan-lock recovery path.

repair.prevention: Preserve an entitled caller-owned non-root continuation instead of rerouting it through the queue.
repair.recovery: After the normal ordered pass, a single-worker tournament may temporarily release and restore an orphaned root lock to select an entitled fallback frontier.
repair.multi_worker_safety: Orphan-lock bypass is disabled when parallel_search_num is greater than one.
